name: allantoin + dimethicone + glycerin
purpose: Temporarily protects and helps relieve chapped, dry, irritated skin. Helps repair and condition skin surface for daily external use.
uses: Do not use on deep wounds, burns or broken skin unless directed by a physician.
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only Avoid contact with eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if skin irritation develops or persists.
